STSO-320.description: Social, cultural and policy analysis of how AI and algorithmic technologies shape and are shaped by people, communities and society.

DHSS-101.name: Computation and Culture
DHSS-101.description: Digital-humanities theory and hands-on scholarly or artistic production using archival, analytical, visualization and presentation platforms, culminating in an online project; no programming background required.

category_review.locator: DHSS-101 complete current rendered course description and credit statement
